title: Curd Rice
description: Cooked rice mashed into whisked curd and tempered with mustard seeds and curry leaves — a cooling, easy-to-digest dish that closes out a South Indian meal.
steps: Cook the rice with water until fully soft, slightly overcooked compared to usual — this makes it easier to mash into the curd.
While the rice is still warm, mash it lightly with a spoon, then mix in the curd, milk (if using) and salt until well combined.
Heat oil in a small pan for tempering. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the urad dal and fry until golden.
Add the dried red chilli, curry leaves and grated ginger, and let them sizzle for 20-30 seconds.
Pour the tempering over the curd rice and mix well.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds if using. Serve at room temperature, or chilled.
